title: the variant form's preorder fields, confirmed preorders and paid file, the read-only list of availability sign-ups, and the statistics screen's commerce figures

brief:
Finish the admin side of P08's catalog and figures. The orchestrator's design decisions below are final; no decoration, no icon, no new dependency.

1. The migration `supabase/migrations/20261003110000_variant_admin_info.sql`: `public.variant_admin_info(p_variant uuid) returns jsonb` exactly as contract section 6 'Admin reads (round 11c)' states: `security definer`, owned by `postgres`, `set search_path = ''`, fully qualified, `finance.require_staff(false)` first, `revoke all ... from public, anon` and `grant execute ... to authenticated` like the round 7b functions. `preorderUnits` sums only committed reservations of the variant with `preorder = true`; `file` comes from `finance.paid_assets` by the variant's `digital_asset` key and never includes the key. Test it in `tests/integration/variant-admin-info.test.ts` (new): anon and an editor refused (42501 or no grant), operations and owner answered; a held, a released and a committed preorder reservation (only the committed one counts; a committed non-preorder one does not); a variant with and without a file; an unknown id `NOT_FOUND`; the reply has no storage key.

2. The variant form (`src/admin/tables/variants.ts`, owner writes, operations reads).
- A new field type `date` in `src/admin/fields.ts` and `FieldInput` (an `<input type="date">`, the value `YYYY-MM-DD`, nullable like the others), used here only.
- Four fields after «المخزون»: «طلب مسبق» (boolean `preorder`), and, visible only while it is on, «سعة الطلب المسبق» (`preorder_capacity`, a whole number from 1), «موعد التسليم» (`preorder_ships_on`, date), «ملاحظة الطلب المسبق» (`preorder_note`, 1 to 300 characters, no control characters, the hint «تظهر للمشتري قبل الدفع.»). While it is on, the three are required and the date may not be before today in Riyadh (`validate`, naming the field: a past date would take the variant off sale); while it is off, `toRow` sends `preorder: false` and null for the three. `toRow` stays within the columns the migrations grant (`tests/unit/collections.test.ts` and `table-rules.test.ts` extended).
- Below the form, for an existing variant (`TableForm` renders it when the table is `variants` and the row has an id), `src/components/admin/VariantCommerce.tsx` reads `variant_admin_info(p_variant)`: «طلبات مسبقة مؤكدة: n» (shown when the variant is a preorder or n > 0) with the sentence «أدخل المخزون الفعلي بعد طرح الطلبات المسبقة المؤكدة.»; for a digital variant, the paid file: the current file («<filename>، <size in KB or MB>، رُفع <formatRiyadh>») or «لا يوجد ملف بعد».
- The paid-file upload, owner only, digital variants only: a file input labelled «رفع الملف المدفوع» accepting `.pdf` and `.epub`; the type is the file's own (`application/pdf`, `application/epub+zip`) or, when the browser gives none, the extension's; anything else, a file over `PAID_FILE_MAX_BYTES`, an empty file or a name over 120 characters or holding a slash or a backslash is refused before any call, with a sentence. Then `paid-file-ticket` `{action, variantId, filename, mime, bytes}` → upload to the signed URL with `supabase.storage.from(bucket).uploadToSignedUrl(path, token, file, {contentType: mime})` → `paid-file-complete` `{action, variantId, ticket, filename, mime}`. A 201 `{assetId, filled}` says «رُفع الملف.» and, when `filled` > 0, «وأُرسل رابط التنزيل إلى <filled> من الطلبات المنتظرة.», then re-reads the info. `BUSY` keeps the ticket and offers «أعد المحاولة» (the same ticket completes again); every other refusal shows the function's message and the next try starts with a new ticket. Progress is one status line («جارٍ الرفع…»), the button disabled while busy; replacing a file is the same upload (the sentence «يحل الملف الجديد محل الحالي في الطلبات الجديدة؛ الطلبات التي استلمت ملفًا تبقى عليه.»).

3. The availability sign-ups, read-only: `src/admin/tables/notifications.ts` (`public.notifications`, read `staff`, `insert: false`), a new `edit: false` flag on `TableConfig` that makes `TableList` render rows without links and removes the table from the edit route's `generateStaticParams`. Columns: email (`dir="ltr"`), the variant's SKU (from the row's variant), status (pending «بانتظار التأكيد», confirmed «مؤكَّد», unsubscribed «ألغى الاشتراك»), the consent revision (its number, or «بلا» when null), created, confirmed. Ordered by created, newest first. A tile «طلبات الإشعار» on `StoreHome` for owner and operations. `scripts/check-export.mjs`: add `admin/store/notifications.html` (and no edit page for it).

4. The statistics screen (`StatsView`): when `commerce` is not null, the section «المتجر» shows the figures of `owner_commerce_stats`, parsed strictly (`src/lib/admin-commerce.ts`): a range with two date inputs «من» and «إلى» (Riyadh days, inclusive; sent as `from` = the start of the first day in Riyadh and `to` = the start of the day after the last, ISO with `+03:00`; empty means the function's 30-day default) and «عرض»; a range over 366 days or ending before it starts is refused by the form; the environment `test` shows «بيانات بيئة الاختبار» above the figures. Figures: «طلبات مدفوعة», «إجمالي المدفوع», «الاستردادات المؤكدة», «الصافي بعد الاستردادات», «العملاء», then «دفعات قيد المراجعة: مفتوحة n، مبالغها <money>، المسترد منها <money>» and «النزاعات: n، على البائع <money>، لصالح البائع <money>», and under them the contract's sentence: «الصافي هنا هو إجمالي المدفوع ناقص الاستردادات المؤكدة. لا يشمل رسوم بوابة الدفع ولا الاعتراضات ولا توقيت التحويل، وليس نقدًا مُسوّى في البنك ولا ربحًا.» The analytics part is unchanged; `commerce: null` keeps today's «غير مُعدّ بعد» sentence.

5. Accessibility and layout at 360 and 1440 as in rounds 11a and 11b: labels, regions mounted first, focus to the result, 44px targets, tables scrolling inside `.tableWrap`.

6. Tests.
- `tests/unit/admin-commerce.test.ts` (new): the parsers of `variant_admin_info` and of `commerce`, the file checks (type from the file or the extension, size, empty, name), the range conversion (Riyadh day boundaries, the 366-day bound, a reversed range), the size wording.
- `tests/e2e/store-admin.spec.ts` extended (real stack, real sign-in, each new test at 360 and 1440): the preorder fields appear only when switched on, a past date and a missing note refused, a saved preorder variant read back; the count of confirmed preorders from a paid preorder order seeded through the service role (`commerceHarness`); a real paid-file upload of a small valid PDF made in the test (the bytes `%PDF-1.4` and a minimal body), the file shown after it, and a text file renamed `.pdf` refused by the function (`NOT_A_PDF`); operations sees the count and the file but no upload control; the notifications list (seed a confirmed and a pending sign-up through the service role) with no row links and no edit page; the statistics figures equal to `owner_commerce_stats` called through the service role for the same range (never hard-coded numbers), the sentence present, a reversed range refused. Screenshots of the variant form (preorder on, paid file) and the statistics section at both widths, no horizontal page overflow. Clean up what the spec created.

Apply the migration with `pnpm exec supabase migration up --local`. Run the dev server only through Playwright's own webServer. Before any e2e run check that at least 10 GB of memory is free; if not, stop leftover headless Chrome processes, and if it is still short report it and skip the e2e run. Copy `next-env.d.ts` aside before an e2e run or a build and restore it after; if `pnpm typecheck` then fails with TS1128 in `.next/e2e`, remove `.next/e2e`.

Never open, read or print a .env file (the repository's, `.env.local` or `supabase/functions/.env`), not even to derive a test value; the test helpers already load what a test needs.

pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/admin-commerce.test.ts tests/unit/collections.test.ts tests/unit/table-rules.test.ts

auditFocus: The migration line by line: security definer, search_path '', owner postgres, the grants (authenticated only, anon and public revoked), the role recheck first, only committed preorder reservations counted, no storage key or buyer detail in the reply. The variant form: `toRow` within the granted columns, the preorder fields required together and off together exactly as the table's check says, no past delivery date, nothing that writes `digital_asset` from the browser. The paid file: owner-only, digital-only, the type and size checked before the ticket, the same bytes uploaded that are completed, `BUSY` keeping its ticket, no storage key shown, the file's name treated as text. The notifications list: read-only in fact (no link, no edit route, no write path), operations and owner only, no consent wording invented. The statistics: figures parsed strictly and equal to the SQL for the same range in the test, the Riyadh day boundaries right, the sentence exact, test labelled. The new `date` field type: no change to how the existing content fields behave (cms.spec green). Accessibility at 360 and 1440.
